name: dreamship
description: Run your print-on-demand shops or make something just for you: products and mockups, publishing to your shops, orders and tracking, draft orders, order fixes and exports.

interface.shortDescription: Design it, sell it, ship it
interface.longDescription:
Run your print-on-demand shops just by asking, or make something just for you. Dreamship prints products such as t-shirts, mugs and posters one at a time, as they're ordered, and ships each one to your customer or to you.

For your shops:
Products and mockups: Add artwork from a file or a link, make and edit products from it, and see their mockups in the chat. Each print area comes with guidance on what the product cuts off, wraps or hides, for artwork made in the chat.
Product templates: Save a product as a template and make more products the same way.
Publishing: Publish products to your connected shops, such as Shopify and Etsy, when you ask.
Orders and tracking: Look up any order, its shipments, tracking and history.
Catalog and costs: Browse the catalog, each item's print areas and mockup templates, and see what an order would cost you, shipping included.
Draft orders: Set up orders for your customers as drafts, then review, submit and pay for them on dreamship.com.
Order fixes: Add, remove or put back a draft order's items, or change its quantities, address, artwork, shipping or reference IDs. An order Dreamship hasn't charged yet can move back to draft to be fixed, and you submit it again on dreamship.com.
Exports: Export your orders, products and catalog, then download the files from Dreamship.

Just for you:
Design a one-off, such as a mug with your dog on it, and the plugin drafts the order to your address. You review, submit and pay for it on dreamship.com, and Dreamship ships it to your door.

Requirements: A Dreamship account. Publishing needs a shop connected in Dreamship, and submitting an order needs a payment method there.

The plugin acts only on your own account, with the permissions your role has on dreamship.com. It cannot submit or cancel an order, change an order Dreamship has already charged, take a product off a shop or charge your account, and it deletes only items you remove from a draft order.
defaultPrompt: Make a mug from my newest artwork and draft an order to ship one to me
Which of my products are on my Shopify store?
What would 3 of my posters cost me shipped to Canada?

positive.description: Lists the products on the merchant's connected Shopify store
positive.prompt: Which of my Dreamship products are on my Shopify store?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected Shopify store, ChatGpt Test Store, and lists the products on it, the Unisex Standard T-Shirt among them.

positive.description: Publishes one of the merchant's products to their Shopify store
positive.prompt: Publish my Standard Poster to my Shopify store.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the Standard Poster to ChatGpt Test Store and reports the listing as publishing or published, or as already published if an earlier run published it. Nothing else on the store changes.

positive.description: Makes a new product from the merchant's existing artwork and shows its mockups
positive.prompt: Make a mug with the same artwork as my Unisex Standard T-Shirt and show me the mockups.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished mug product in the merchant's account with the T-shirt's artwork and shows the product card. The mockups appear on the card once they finish rendering, usually within a couple of minutes.

positive.description: Estimates what an order would cost the merchant, shipping included
positive.prompt: What would 3 of my Standard Posters cost me shipped to Canada?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the cost of 3 posters with shipping to Canada, by shipping method, at the merchant's own prices. Nothing is ordered.

positive.description: Creates a draft order that the merchant reviews and submits on Dreamship
positive.prompt: Create a draft order for 2 black size M Unisex Standard T-Shirts for Jane Doe, 860 Fell St, San Francisco, CA 94117.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft order for 2 black M T-shirts shipping to Jane Doe and shows the order card. The order stays a draft: nothing is charged or printed unless the merchant submits it on dreamship.com.

negative.description: Cancelling an order, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Cancel my order for Jane Doe.
negative.expected_behavior: Cancels nothing. Says it can't cancel orders here; it may look the order up first.

negative.description: Taking a product off a shop, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Take my Unisex Standard T-Shirt off my Shopify store.
negative.expected_behavior: Changes nothing on the store. Says it can't take products off shops.

negative.description: Image generation that has nothing to do with the merchant's Dreamship account
negative.prompt: Generate an image of a cat wearing sunglasses.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't call the plugin, and nothing is added to the merchant's Dreamship account.

review.commerce_description: People can create draft orders for physical print-on-demand products made from their own designs, shipped to their customers or to themselves. Nothing is bought or charged in the plugin: they review, submit and pay for each order on dreamship.com, and the plugin cannot submit, charge or cancel an order.

publication.release_notes: Change draft orders by asking: add, remove or put back items, change quantities, shipping, 48-hour fulfillment and reference IDs, or print a catalog item with your artwork on an unmatched item. Each print area now comes with guidance on what the product cuts off, wraps or hides, for artwork made in the chat. You still review, submit and pay for every order on dreamship.com.
